title: Chapter 196 The Other Four
content:
Chapter 196 The Other Four

Seeing such a scene, Wang Shuo focused on that sentence.

Since the village has asked for help, why haven't any reinforcements arrived?

Even a 10-man squad of soldiers should be able to handle this scene.

Could it be that there were other things that delayed it?

There were too few clues, and Wang Shuo could only guess based on thin air.

At this time, Wang Shuo looked at the room carefully.

Among the broken armor fragments, a blueprint and a small tiger-shaped object were found.

[Circle formation drawing +1, tiger talisman +1, energy crystal +200, soul crystal +10]

[Tiger Talisman: The bearer’s control value +500. 】

"Go ahead, this is awesome!"

It is equivalent to the holder being able to directly command 5,000 troops.

Wang Shuo couldn't help but feel elated.

Pack these two things.

Wang Shuo began to explore other places.

On the map, there are only three places marked in the main hall. In addition to the main hall that you just entered, they are the military aircraft department and the command center.

These places have been explored.

Wang Shuo passed through a back door and arrived outside the main hall.

At this time, the fog on the map dissipated.

Beyond the back door, there is a vast area marked as the back garden.

In the back garden, there are also marked research institutes, dining halls, internal affairs offices, and water pavilions in the middle of the lake.

There is also a place that is not marked with a name, but is marked with a huge red dot. It looks like an extremely dangerous place.

After Wang Shuo thought about it for a while, he decided to go to the nearest dining hall first.

After walking a few steps, Wang Shuo noticed something unusual.

Many people in his own army seemed a little abnormal at this time.

There was a trace of black aura lingering on their bodies, as if they were contaminated by the aura of death. After questioning these people, they still seemed to be in normal consciousness.

But there are still some people who do not have the aura of death lingering on them.

Wang Shuo thought about it carefully and realized that these people, including himself, were all people who had been injured before and had taken the water of life.

Could it be that the water of life can resist the energy of death?

Wang Shuo had some guesses in his mind.

Seeing that everyone was fine now, Wang Shuo stepped up the pace of exploration.

The dining hall is an independent contiguous building.

When I walked in, I saw that it was empty. There was no fireworks in the kitchen and the stove was covered with dust.

In the hall where the servants dine, tables, chairs and benches are staggered and it is a mess.

It wasn't until Wang Shuo walked to the storage room that he discovered that the ground was supposed to be dusty.

There are actually some messy footprints.

It can even be seen that there are some signs of fighting.

Has anyone been here?

Wang Shuo thought that when he entered the underground palace, he was reminded that there were already four people inside.

Most of the dining hall was explored by these four people.

Meanwhile, somewhere in the back garden.

One man and three women were fighting an undead boss.

The man's name is Locke. He has yellow hair and blue eyes. He looks like a Westerner at first glance.

He held a shield and a dagger in his hands, and wore tight-fitting leather armor. Although he was not tall, he looked very strong and had the posture of a Spartan warrior.

There are three other women, one of whom is dressed in black, has blond hair in braids, has a beautiful and refined appearance, and is holding a short blade. She looks like an assassin.

One person was wearing a fancy outfit and holding a samurai sword in both hands. Under her neat short hair, there was a pair of sharp eyes like a falcon. She had three sword scabbards on her waist, one of which was a short sword that was not unsheathed.

The last person is a young girl with a slim figure, picturesque eyebrows, bright eyes like water, and skin like gelatin. She is wearing a long snow-white dress, which makes her even more elegant and refined.

She looked like a fairy in the painting. At this time, she also frowned slightly, paying close attention to the undead boss in front of her.

The four of them faced the enemy together, but they also stood apart and were on guard against each other.
